classical_and_foundational_inputs.scope: GdEnd is an explicit antecedent of UCE19, not a conclusion. It fixes one marked g1 supplying FinEnd, AutEnd3 and AutEnd2 together before all universal rings, coefficient curves, arbitrary entry maps and actual outer extensions. UCE12 separately assumes FinEnd; UCE13--UCE16 separately assume FinA. The all-curve FinEnd subgroup is chosen before the curves. AutEnd3 retains every open subgroup and every K-algebra structure; AutEnd2 retains every original extension W and the fixed complex bridge.

classical_and_foundational_inputs.title: Elementary valuation, complete local and finite-dimensional algebra
classical_and_foundational_inputs.scope: A valuation ring dominates a local domain; Gaussian elimination over valuation rings; Zariski lemma; the principal ideal theorem and finite prime avoidance; Hensel lifting and complete Nakayama. The applied flag specialization, curve construction, homogeneous monomial spanning, torus rescaling, continuous extension, trace Gram argument and normal-core irreducibility argument are proved explicitly. No Brauer--Nesbitt theorem, division by the rank or factorial, automorphy or end-condition producer is used as an extra foundation.
